definitions.explanation: The position or way in which someone holds their body.
One's way of thinking about or approaching something.

examples.japanese: {姿勢|しせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}して→正す：10132_tadasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{姿勢|しせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Bad posture is not good for your body.

examples.english: I want to fix my hunched back and maintain good posture.

examples.english: When using a computer for long hours, your posture tends to deteriorate, so I try to take regular breaks.

⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{姿勢|しせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}された→評価：03583_hyouka⟧。

examples.english: The company's stance on environmental issues is being criticized.

notes:
{姿勢|しせい} covers both meanings of English 'posture': how you hold your body, and the stance you take toward something. The two senses share the same collocations — a {姿勢|しせい} can be ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ or ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ either way.

PHYSICAL POSTURE:
- {姿勢|しせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧ (to straighten up)
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{姿勢|しせい} (correct posture)
- {姿勢|しせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (to have poor posture; see ⟦{猫背|ねこぜ}→猫背：10133_nekoze⟧ for the hunched kind)

ATTITUDE OR STANCE:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{姿勢|しせい} (one's stance on ~)
- ⟦{前向|まえむ}きな→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧{姿勢|しせい} (a positive, forward-looking attitude)
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧な{姿勢|しせい} (a proactive attitude)
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧な{姿勢|しせい} (a passive attitude)
- ⟦{低|てい}{姿勢|しせい}→低姿勢：10135_teishisei⟧ (keeping a low profile, being deferential)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ - attitude as it shows in behaviour toward people; {姿勢|しせい} is the considered position an organisation or person takes on an issue, and is the word news reports use.
